mapper.select: SELECT C4M_IDX AS c4m_idx, C4M_NO AS c4m_no, C4M_RECV AS c4m_recv, C4M_SCOPE AS c4m_scope, C4M_M4 AS c4m_m4, C4M_ORIGIN AS c4m_origin, C4M_DEPT AS c4m_dept, C4M_OWNER AS c4m_owner, C4M_PROD_CODE AS c4m_prod_code, C4M_CUST AS c4m_cust, C4M_MODEL AS c4m_model, C4M_PN AS c4m_pn, C4M_PNAME AS c4m_pname, C4M_TARGET AS c4m_target, C4M_BEFORE AS c4m_before, C4M_AFTER AS c4m_after, C4M_WHY AS c4m_why, C4M_GRADE AS c4m_grade, C4M_REP AS c4m_rep, C4M_APPR AS c4m_appr, C4M_VITEM AS c4m_vitem, C4M_VRES AS c4m_vres, C4M_PLAN AS c4m_plan, C4M_START AS c4m_start, C4M_FLOW AS c4m_flow, C4M_STATUS AS c4m_status, C4M_END AS c4m_end, C4M_MEMO AS c4m_memo, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), C4M_REG_DATE, 120) AS c4m_reg_date FROM CHANGE4M WITH(NOLOCK) ORDER BY C4M_RECV DESC, C4M_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHANGE4M (C4M_NO, C4M_RECV, C4M_SCOPE, C4M_M4, C4M_ORIGIN, C4M_DEPT, C4M_OWNER, C4M_PROD_CODE, C4M_CUST, C4M_MODEL, C4M_PN, C4M_PNAME, C4M_TARGET, C4M_BEFORE, C4M_AFTER, C4M_WHY, C4M_GRADE, C4M_REP, C4M_APPR, C4M_VITEM, C4M_VRES, C4M_PLAN, C4M_START, C4M_FLOW, C4M_STATUS, C4M_END, C4M_MEMO) VALUES (#{c4m_no}, #{c4m_recv}, #{c4m_scope}, #{c4m_m4}, #{c4m_origin}, #{c4m_dept}, #{c4m_owner}, #{c4m_prod_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{c4m_cust}, #{c4m_model}, #{c4m_pn}, #{c4m_pname}, #{c4m_target}, #{c4m_before}, #{c4m_after}, #{c4m_why}, #{c4m_grade}, #{c4m_rep}, #{c4m_appr}, #{c4m_vitem}, #{c4m_vres}, #{c4m_plan}, #{c4m_start}, #{c4m_flow,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{c4m_status}, #{c4m_end}, #{c4m_memo})
mapper.update: UPDATE CHANGE4M SET C4M_NO = #{c4m_no}, C4M_RECV = #{c4m_recv}, C4M_SCOPE = #{c4m_scope}, C4M_M4 = #{c4m_m4}, C4M_ORIGIN = #{c4m_origin}, C4M_DEPT = #{c4m_dept}, C4M_OWNER = #{c4m_owner}, C4M_PROD_CODE = #{c4m_prod_code,jdbcType=INTEGER}, C4M_CUST = #{c4m_cust}, C4M_MODEL = #{c4m_model}, C4M_PN = #{c4m_pn}, C4M_PNAME = #{c4m_pname}, C4M_TARGET = #{c4m_target}, C4M_BEFORE = #{c4m_before}, C4M_AFTER = #{c4m_after}, C4M_WHY = #{c4m_why}, C4M_GRADE = #{c4m_grade}, C4M_REP = #{c4m_rep}, C4M_APPR = #{c4m_appr}, C4M_VITEM = #{c4m_vitem}, C4M_VRES = #{c4m_vres}, C4M_PLAN = #{c4m_plan}, C4M_START = #{c4m_start}, C4M_FLOW = #{c4m_flow,jdbcType=INTEGER}, C4M_STATUS = #{c4m_status}, C4M_END = #{c4m_end}, C4M_MEMO = #{c4m_memo} WHERE C4M_IDX = #{c4m_idx}
mapper.select:
SELECT TOP 50 P.PROD_CODE AS c4m_prod_code, P.PROD_NO AS c4m_pn, P.PROD_NAME AS c4m_pname, ISNULL(C.CORP_NAME,'') AS c4m_cust FROM PRODUCT P WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CORP C WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CORP_CODE = P.CORP_CODE
AND (P.PROD_NO LIKE '%'+#{value}+'%' OR P.PROD_NAME LIKE '%'+#{value}+'%')
ORDER BY P.PROD_NO
